  1. [Search-A], [Search-B] -> [FareConfirm] POST mixing Search-A's responseId with Search-B's selectedOfferId -> observe response

Preconditions
Search returns at least one offer with a full passengerFareBreakdown
Steps
  1. For each offer: sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount; sum((paxBaseAmount+taxes)*paxCount) reconciles to priceDetails.totalAmount.amount; totalBaseAmount == sum(paxBaseAmount*paxCount); totalTaxAmount == sum(taxes*paxCount)
Expected Result
All four reconciliation checks hold for every offer and every passenger type present.
Actual Result

Preconditions
Search response includes the relevant capability flags for the selected offer

Flags match between the two responses for the same offer; a flag flipping between steps is itself a defect worth reporting, not expected behavior.

View Test Case
Preconditions
A completed Book with a known voidCapability value
Steps
  1. [Book] -> record voidCapability -> [Void] POST -> observe whether the call succeeds or is rejected, correlated against the recorded voidCapability value
Expected Result
A booking whose voidCapability read 'VoidNotAllowed' at Book time is not voidable; treat the live per-booking flag as authoritative over the static section 4.2 matrix's supplier-level Void column.
Actual Result
Blocked: the precondition cannot be produced on SabreNdc/EGY. Book returns voidCapability=FullVoidOnlyAllowed every time (Book:FullVoidOnlyAllowed x20, Hold:VoidNotAllowed x21); only Hold responses carry "VoidNotAllowed" (a held booking has no ticket to void). No Book response with VoidNotAllowed exists to compare with a Void outcome. Exploratory check on the Hold flag: V1: Hold read voidCapability=VoidNotAllowed; Void on that held PNR -> 400 code=NDC-INT-TEC-A0001 msg="Invalid request. Please check the request parameters and try again." ctx=[{"Value":"Only fulfilled, ticketed orders can be voided."}] | V2: Hold read voidCapability=VoidNotAllowed; Void on that held PNR -> 400 code=NDC-INT-TEC-A0001 msg="Invalid request. Please check the request parameters and try again." ctx=[{"Value":"Only fulfilled, ticketed orders can be voided."}]

Preconditions
Comparable V1 and V2 flows executable against the same/equivalent supplier
Steps
  1. For each endpoint, apply the section 2.1 reconciliation formula manually and separately note whether the collection's own script already enforces it for that version
Expected Result
V1 enforces the reconciliation formula at Search, FareConfirm, Book, Hold, Retrieve, FareConfirmAfterHold, and BookAfterHold; V2 enforces it only at Hold, FareConfirmAfterHold, and BookAfterHold -- manual testing must independently apply the formula at every V2 endpoint the script skips (Search, FareConfirm, Book, Retrieve).

Search/FareConfirm succeed technically for the chosen blacklisted supplier

  1. [Search] -> [FareConfirm] -> [Book] POST against the blacklisted supplier -> observe whether the booking-affecting action is blocked

Blocked/rejected at the business layer even though technically reachable through Search/FareConfirm; exact rejection mechanism UNKNOWN, confirm live.
